FAQs

Common Questions Before You Book

Find answers to common questions about our repairs, servicing, turnaround times and the vehicles we work on before booking with our team.

View All FAQs

Do I need to bring my vehicle to your workshop?

Yes. Most repairs are carried out at our workshop so we have the right tools, materials, equipment and safety setup available.

How long will the repair take?

Timeframes depend on the complexity of the job. Once we understand what needs repairing, we can give you a clearer estimate before work begins.

What makes and models do you work on?

We work on all makes and models, including New Zealand-built, imported, custom-built and older vehicles.

Can you help with a small repair?

Yes. We handle small repairs, maintenance work, upgrades and major rebuilds. If you are unsure, send us a few details and we can let you know the next step.

Do you work on imported caravans and motorhomes?

Yes. We work on imported, older and less common models that need specialist repair knowledge.

Can you repair water damage?

Yes. We can assess leaks and water damage, repair affected areas, and help identify the cause to reduce the risk of further damage.
